feature: kernel-enforced tenant CPU/RAM budget admission and accounting

policy.resources_enforced: CPU budget metadata and RAM admission
policy.admission: RAM demand above active tenant limit returns EDQUOT
policy.current_usage: budget reduction below observed aggregate returns EDQUOT
policy.snapshot: tenant budget and over-budget state exposed with generation
policy.lifecycle: set, query, and clear operations; clear revokes active budget

limitations: GPU/NPU/VRAM/storage/network/IO tenant budgets remain unsupported and fail closed rather than being falsely reported as enforced.
This adds tenant budget admission and accounting but does not create cgroup hierarchies or replace cgroup v2 enforcement.
CPU budget is exposed and accounted; deadline scheduling and hard CPU-time throttling remain separate work.
No claim of multi-host tenant isolation or physical accelerator qualification is made.
